# Kenney Furniture Pack stool

The square stool is from Kenney's Furniture Pack 1.0. The supplied
License.txt identifies the pack as Creative Commons Zero, CC0.
The author permits personal and commercial use and optional attribution.

- Author and pack page — https://kenney.nl/assets/furniture-kit
- Author-posted archive — https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/kenney_furniturePack.zip
- Licence checked on 2026-11-04 against the official pack page and the
  included License.txt. The official download endpoint refused the request,
  so the older author-posted OpenGameArt archive supplied these files.
- stoolBarSquare.obj and stoolBarSquare.mtl are unchanged source files.
- The game's derived stool uses short camp-seat proportions, one matte
  dark-wood material and a floor-centred origin. The original seat and frame
  are recoloured as wood. Rebuild with tools/stool_review/build_stool.py.
- The derived model is 142 triangles and has a 40 × 32 cm seat footprint
  with a 43 cm seat height. Exact source/export hashes are recorded in
  art/dressing/camp-stool-v1/provenance.json.
